name: ACT utilities concession
summary: Yearly rebate on energy bills for Canberra residents who are the primary holder of a Health Care Card.
who: Primary holder of an eligible card, including the Health Care Card and Low Income Health Care Card
how: Embedded network residents can call the ACT Revenue Office on (02) 6207 0028 or apply online.
catches: Health Care Card holders must reapply each time a new card is issued.
The Commonwealth Seniors Health Card is not eligible.

evidence.quote: Eligible applicants must be the primary holder of one of the following concession cards
